elements.text:
Your friend enjoys ice skating and convinces you to try it out. At the rink you put on the skates and step on the ice. You glide forward slowly at first, then faster. 

Here are some feelings that might happen in the moment:

texts: It feels exhilerating to skate fast.
I feel happy my friend invited me skating.
I feel terrified of falling over.
I'm anxious about wiping out, but know it happens to everyone at some point.
I'm a little nervous about falling over, but know I'm unlikley to get badly hurt.
